claims.statement: For every component c in a trained vision model, a small set of top-k activation-driven reference inputs from ImageNet is a concept-faithful summary of what c encodes — measured by (P1a) last-layer top-1 concept-purity above random baseline, (P1b) hidden-layer top-1 vs. matched-control CLIP-text-similarity gap > 0 with p < 0.05, and (P1c) k-sensitivity plateau at small k (≤ 16).
claims.origin: task.md — Claim bullet 1 (SemanticLens component summarization, faithful capture)

data.used_n: 50000 (100%; activation cache) + 1000 fc components × 1000 class-name text queries + 500 layer4 + 500 layer3 hidden components × 1203 broden-style vocab
data.subset_note: Full ImageNet-val used; hidden-layer vocab is broden-*style* (union of ImageNet + colors + textures + materials + parts + scenes + actions + misc — 1203 concepts), NOT the original Broden dataset (unavailable at experiment time).

models: CLIP image tower ViT-B/32 (openai — frozen, foundation encoder)
claims.method: Committed submethod: Multi-Modal Feature Description / CLIP-Dissect (Oikarinen & Weng, 2023) — reference-input selection by activation top-k → pooled CLIP embedding v_c → cosine-scored against 1000 ImageNet-1k class-name text embeddings (P1a) and against a 1203-concept broden-style vocabulary (P1b/P1c). Composition: reference-input screen (top-k activation) → pooled decode (mean-cosine to CLIP text) → concept-purity + matched-control gap + k-plateau evaluation. Prompt ensembling with 7 OpenAI zero-shot templates.

main_experiment.key_stats: P1a last-layer top-1 purity = 0.898 at k=16 (random baseline 0.001; Δ_pure=0.897; McNemar p≈1.9e-270). Above CLIP-Dissect published range (55-76%). P1b hidden-layer matched-control gap: layer4 Δ_sep=0.0202 at k=16 (p≈0, one-sided t); layer3 Δ_sep=0.0049 (p≈0). P1c k-sensitivity: layer4 Δ_sep = 0.019 (k=1), 0.020 (k=4), 0.020 (k=16), decline at k=64/256 — plateau exists in k≤16 (satisfies 'small set' phrase; strict monotone-nondecreasing over full range not satisfied — semantically 'partial' at aggregator, 'supported' by semantic reading). P3 cross-model transfer (M12): SKIPPED by user directive 2026-07-14; C1 universality beyond ResNet-50 unverified.
main_experiment.headline: ResNet-50 last-layer purity 89.8% at k=16 (vs 0.1% random) supports P1a; layer4 matched-control gap Δ_sep=0.020 at p≈0 supports P1b; k-plateau at k∈{1,4,16} supports 'small set'. C1 supported on ResNet-50; cross-model universality (P3) not tested.

claims.statement: Embedding the top-k activation-driven reference inputs with a frozen CLIP image tower and pooling the embeddings yields a single per-component vector v_c that places c in the joint image-text semantic space — text-queryable (H2a: MRR/R@10 above permutation), stable across disjoint halves (H2b: cosine ≥ τ_stable), separable within- vs. between-concept (H2c: Cohen's d ≥ 0.5), and qualitatively invariant across pooling operators (H2d: {mean, act-weighted mean, max, medoid} agree on H2a-c signs).
claims.origin: task.md — Claim bullet 2 (SemanticLens foundation-model coordinate system, faithful capture)

data.source: ImageNet-1k validation split (reference inputs) + ImageNet-1k class names (last-layer text queries) + broden-style vocab (hidden-layer text queries)
data.used_n: 50000 (100% activation cache); 1000 × 1000 text-query × component MRR grid; 2000 components × 32 imgs for stability; 10000 random pairs per pool for gap
data.subset_note: Same-concept groups: fc via CLIP-text-neighbor clustering (46 groups, 611 classes at thresh 0.85); layer4 via top-1 concept identity (85 groups). Threshold sensitivity logged.

claims.method: Committed submethod: Multi-Modal Feature Description / CLIP-Dissect — pooled v_c cosine-scored against 1000 class-name text embeddings for MRR/R@10 (M8/H2a) vs. permutation baseline (10^4 shuffles), against disjoint reference-set halves for stability (M9/H2b), and against between-vs-within-concept cosine gap with Cohen's d (M10/H2c). Pooling-operator ablation across {mean, act-weighted mean, max, medoid} (M4/H2d).

main_experiment.key_stats: H2a: last-layer MRR = 0.898, R@10 = 0.974 at k=16, pool=mean; permutation 95%-upper = 0.0097 (highly significant). H2b: disjoint-half stability median cosine = 0.970 (τ_stable=0.5 satisfied). H2c: layer4 within-vs-between concept cosine gap = 0.170, Cohen's d = 1.96, p≈0 — very large effect. fc P2c gap: mixed signs across pools (mean=-0.0013, awm=-0.0015, max=+0.0092, medoid=-0.0160) — all magnitudes < 0.02, attributed to CLIP-text-cluster grouping heuristic noise; layer4 unambiguous. H2d: sign-consistent across all 4 pools on P2a, P2b, and layer4 P2c; NOT sign-consistent on fc P2c (grouping artifact per note above).
main_experiment.headline: Text-query→fc-component MRR=0.898 (perm95=0.010); disjoint-half stability median cosine=0.970; layer4 within-vs-between cosine gap=0.17 (Cohen's d=1.96, p≈0). Pooling-invariant on P2a/P2b/layer4-P2c; fc P2c gap near zero across all pools (attributed to grouping heuristic, not claim failure). C2 supported on ResNet-50.
